title: get api deals with filtering and pagination
description: Verify GET /api/deals endpoint returns 200 with correctly filtered discounted deals list when using parameters onlyDiscounted, search, brands[], categories[], minPrice, maxPrice, sortBy, page, and pageSize.

title: get api products with filtering and pagination
description: Verify GET /api/products endpoint returns 200 with full product list when using parameters onlyDiscounted=false, search, brands[], categories[], minPrice, maxPrice, sortBy, page, and pageSize.

title: get api store deals with filtering and pagination
description: Verify GET /api/store-deals endpoint returns 200 with store campaign deals list when using parameters search, categories[], sortBy, page, and pageSize.

title: get api products by id with valid and invalid ids
description: Verify GET /api/products/{id} returns 200 with product detail for valid id and 404 for non-existent product id.

title: get api products price history with valid and invalid days
description: Verify GET /api/products/{id}/price-history returns 200 with price history data for valid days parameter (7,15,30,180,365) and 400 for invalid days parameter.

title: get api products sparklines with valid ids and days
description: Verify GET /api/products/sparklines returns 200 with sparkline data for up to 100 valid product ids and valid days parameter.

title: get api brand comparison with valid and invalid brands
description: Verify GET /api/brand-comparison returns 200 with comparison data for valid brand1 and brand2 parameters, 400 or 404 for invalid or missing brand parameters.

title: get api coupons returns active coupon codes
description: Verify GET /api/coupons returns 200 with list of active coupon codes or empty list when no coupons are available.

title: get api articles list and detail with valid and invalid slugs
description: Verify GET /api/articles returns 200 with guide article list or empty list, and GET /api/articles/{slug} returns 200 with article detail for valid slug and 404 or 400 for unknown or malformed slug.

title: get go product redirect with click tracking
description: Verify GET /go/{productId} returns 302 redirect to merchant store page and tracks the click for valid productId.
